svg.title: P25: Scope-based authorization and profiles collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · registry role collaboration
A caller invokes a method or service with an
Capability is checked against a requested scope.
Scope identity, profile, grant and revocation
The call is permitted only if the principal
Authorization is evaluated at the call
boundary and records the covering scope.
Scopes are not inherited beyond declared
1 resolve(capability) → 2 load(profile) → 3 check(scope) → 4 invoke(scoped_call) → 5 return(result) → 6 deny(failure)
Evidence: 41/41 repositories, 36/36 families; 41 trajectories (20 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Method scopes, roles, session grants, profiles, and delegated identities.
Negative control: A boolean admin flag is not a scope model.
